cast.name: Narrator
cast.look: The voice of the deep dive: a sharp woman in her 30s, dark hair in a bun, teal blazer over a cream blouse, present-day.

cast.name: Young Steven Pressfield
cast.look: Steven Pressfield at 23 in 1967 and through his starving screenwriter years: a slim young man, short side-parted brown hair, narrow charcoal suit, white shirt, thin black tie.

cast.name: Steven Pressfield
cast.look: Steven Pressfield as the veteran author of The War of Art: a man in his 60s, receding grey hair, round glasses, olive canvas field jacket over a denim shirt.

cast.name: Shawn Coyne
cast.look: Shawn Coyne, Pressfield's editor, a man in his 40s, short black hair, full dark beard, rolled-up sky-blue shirt sleeves, brown vest, sorting manuscript pages on his office floor.

cast.name: The reader
cast.look: The busy, distracted reader every writer is up against: a woman in her 30s, high ponytail, bright red trench coat, coffee cup and phone in hand, always about to walk away.

cast.name: The aspiring writer
cast.look: The aspiring writer and the viewer: a man in his 30s, messy brown hair, stubble, mustard-yellow hoodie and jeans, at a desk at 2 a.m., present-day.

cast.name: The client
cast.look: The ad-agency client in love with his own product: a stout bald man in his 50s, bushy mustache, loud green plaid suit, bowtie, 1960s.

cast.name: Veteran ad man
cast.look: A veteran Madison Avenue copywriter in his 50s, grey crew cut, white shirt with rolled sleeves and red suspenders, 1960s.

cast.name: Gordon Gekko
cast.look: Gordon Gekko from Wall Street (1987): a man in his 40s, slicked-back dark hair, navy pinstripe double-breasted suit, white-collar blue shirt, yellow tie, at a microphone.

cast.name: Jake Gittes
cast.look: Private eye Jake Gittes from Chinatown: a man in his 30s, cream linen suit, brown fedora, white bandage across his nose, 1930s Los Angeles.

cast.name: Noah Cross
cast.look: Noah Cross from Chinatown: a polite, grandfatherly tycoon in his 70s, white hair, white mustache, brown tweed suit, 1930s Los Angeles.

cast.name: Achilles
cast.look: Achilles of Homer's Iliad: a young Greek warrior, bronze armor, crested bronze helmet, red cloak, sword and round shield, Trojan War.

cast.name: Tony Soprano
cast.look: Tony Soprano: a heavy mob boss in his 40s, receding dark hair, white tank top under an open maroon bathrobe, New Jersey suburbs.

cast.name: Robert McKee
cast.look: Screenwriting teacher Robert McKee: a man in his 60s, swept-back silver hair, black glasses, black blazer over a black shirt, lecturing at a hotel-ballroom seminar.

cast.name: The professor
cast.look: A history professor grading papers: a woman in her 60s, grey bun, half-moon glasses, plum cardigan vest over a white blouse.

cast.name: The grandmother
cast.look: An immigrant grandmother crossing the ocean to America around 1910: a woman in her 20s, dark headscarf, long brown wool coat, a battered suitcase.

cast.name: Police officer
cast.look: A highway patrol officer writing a speeding ticket: a man in his 40s, dark blue uniform, peaked cap, badge, mirrored sunglasses.
